task: Schedule a recurring weekly team standup meeting
description: The user wants to create a recurring 15-minute standup meeting every Monday at 9 AM for the engineering team of 8 people, finding a time that works for everyone and sending calendar invites.

task: Draft a professional email declining a meeting invitation
description: The user received a meeting invitation that conflicts with a higher-priority commitment and wants to draft a polite email declining, suggesting alternative times, and offering to send notes instead.

task: Set up a video conference with international participants across time zones
description: The user needs to schedule a 1-hour meeting with participants in New York, London, and Tokyo, finding a time that falls within business hours for all three time zones and generating a video conference link.

task: Search for a specific document shared last month
description: The user remembers a quarterly sales report that a colleague shared via email or cloud drive sometime last month but cannot find it. They want to search across email, Google Drive, and Slack.

task: Create and prioritize a task list for a product launch
description: The user needs to create a structured task list for an upcoming product launch in 3 weeks, assign priorities, set deadlines, and assign tasks to 4 team members.

task: Find a colleague's phone number and schedule a call
description: The user needs to reach a specific person in the marketing department, look up their contact information in the company directory, and schedule a 30-minute phone call for this afternoon.

task: Take meeting notes and distribute action items
description: The user just finished a project meeting and wants to organize their raw notes into a structured summary with key decisions, action items with owners, and deadlines, then send it to all attendees.

task: Set multiple reminders for the day's errands and deadlines
description: The user has a busy day and needs reminders: pick up dry cleaning at 3 PM, submit a report by 5 PM, call the dentist before noon, and buy groceries after work.

task: Share a large file securely with external stakeholders
description: The user needs to share a 500MB design file with a client, setting up a secure sharing link with an expiration date, password protection, and download tracking.

task: Create a project timeline with milestones and dependencies
description: The user is planning a 3-month software project and needs to create a timeline with 8 milestones, define task dependencies, identify the critical path, and share the Gantt chart with the team.

task: Reschedule all meetings for a sick day
description: The user is feeling sick and needs to cancel or reschedule all 4 meetings on today's calendar, send apology emails to attendees, and propose new times for the rescheduled ones.

task: Organize inbox by archiving old emails and creating filters
description: The user has an overflowing inbox with 2,000 unread emails and wants to bulk-archive newsletters older than 30 days, create filters for recurring senders, and set up labels for key projects.

task: Prepare a weekly status update email for the manager
description: The user wants to compile their completed tasks, in-progress work, and blockers from the past week into a formatted status update email for their manager.

task: Set up an out-of-office auto-reply for a vacation
description: The user is going on vacation for 2 weeks and needs to set up an out-of-office auto-reply with a custom message, specify the date range, and designate an alternate contact for urgent matters.

task: Coordinate a team lunch poll and booking
description: The user wants to send a poll to 10 team members to vote on a lunch restaurant, collect responses by tomorrow noon, and book a reservation at the winning restaurant for Friday.

task: Consolidate notes from multiple meetings into a project brief
description: The user has notes from 5 different meetings over the past 2 weeks and wants to extract key decisions, merge them into a coherent project brief document, and share it with stakeholders.

task: Block focus time on the calendar for deep work
description: The user wants to block 2-hour focus time slots every morning from Tuesday to Thursday for the next month, marking them as busy and declining any conflicting meeting invitations.

task: Create an agenda and send pre-read materials for a board meeting
description: The user is organizing a quarterly board meeting and needs to create a detailed agenda, attach 3 pre-read documents, send the package to 12 board members, and request RSVPs by a deadline.
